confirmed_defects.what: fetch_board hardcodes ListFilters { archived: false, ..Default::default() }. The dashboard's 'SHOW ARCHIVED' toolbar toggle reveals the 7th column, but fetch_board never returns archived tasks, so the column is always empty regardless of toggle state.
confirmed_defects.how_to_fix: Add an `include_archived: bool` parameter to fetch_board (defaulting to false), and have ScreenKanban call fetch_board with the current archived_visible signal value when it changes. Alternative: split into fetch_board() + fetch_archived() and merge client-side. Either way the client must re-fetch when the user toggles SHOW ARCHIVED on.
confirmed_defects.test_gap: tests/kanban_board_read.rs and tests/kanban_full_suite.rs both fixture out archived-fetch coverage; no test asserts that toggling archived_visible causes an archived task to appear. Add a regression test before fix lands.

confirmed_defects.what: The drawer panel and the four modals (Complete, Block, ArchiveConfirm, CreateTask) render with insufficient background contrast — the underlying board bleeds through, form labels/inputs/buttons are hard to read. UI-SPEC §3.9/§3.10 want a themed boundary edge + slight tinted fill matching the existing HermesApp card style (see Settings screen UI PREFERENCES card for the canonical look).
confirmed_defects.how_to_fix: Apply the same card treatment used by the Settings screen UI PREFERENCES card: cyan-border (var(--accent-primary)) at the drawer/modal edge, opaque dark fill (slightly lighter than --bg-base so the boundary is visible), and a clear z-index layer separation. Reference the working examples in screens/settings.rs and the shared .card / .panel CSS rules.
confirmed_defects.test_gap: Visual; not unit-testable. UAT row U2 is the contract.
confirmed_defects.affected_plan: 03 (drawer + modals shipped here; CSS in kanban.css)
